tools.name: check_link_preview
tools.description: Scores how a page looks when shared on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Telegram, WhatsApp and Slack, and lists the og: and twitter: tags to fix. Use it before launch or after changing meta tags. Free, no account. Show the person the report link from the result.

tools.name: check_site_previews
tools.description: Checks up to 50 pages from the sitemap: which have no image, share one image, or are broken. Each call waits up to 25 seconds; if the check isn't finished, call again with the check_id from the result. Free, no account.

tools.name: create_previews
tools.description: Creates branded Open Graph image designs for a site with AI and returns a link where the person picks one, tweaks it and publishes. Needs a free getwowlink account. Always show the person the picker link from the result, as is (they can't continue without it), then call wait_for_design until they pu

tools.name: wait_for_design
tools.description: Waits until the person has picked and published a design, then says what to install. Each call waits up to 25 seconds; call it again until the state is published.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: The og:image and twitter:image tags for every page, with the image URL pattern for this site. Apply the text from the result to the site's code, then call verify_install once it is deployed. The design must be published first.

tools.name: verify_install
tools.description: Checks live pages: exactly one og:image, served by getwowlink, and whether crawlers already fetch the images. Call it after deploying the tags from get_install_instructions. Checks the home page unless you pass paths (up to 5, each starting with "/").

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.getwowlink.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_install_instructions · Public sink: check_site_previews, create_previews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_install_instructions · Public sink: check_site_previews, create_previews

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
